text.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَيْلٌۭ لِّكُلِّ هُمَزَةٍۢ لُّمَزَةٍ

translations.sahih: Woe to every scorner and mocker

translations.asad: [Woe unto him who amasses wealth and counts it a safeguard,
translations.sahih: Who collects wealth and [continuously] counts it.

translations.asad: thinking that his wealth will make him live forever!
translations.sahih: He thinks that his wealth will make him immortal.

translations.asad: Nay, but [in the life to come such as] he shall indeed be abandoned to crushing torment!
translations.sahih: No! He will surely be thrown into the Crusher.

translations.asad: And what could make thee conceive what that crushing torment will be?
translations.sahih: And what can make you know what is the Crusher?
It is the fire of Allah, [eternally] fueled,

translations.asad: which will rise over the [guilty] hearts:
translations.sahih: Which mounts directed at the hearts.

translations.asad: verily, it will close in upon them
translations.sahih: Indeed, Hellfire will be closed down upon them
